Requirements You are in @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.archetypes.vNck1Oor9udzoSRj]{Storm Surge Stance}.

You launch yourself forward and thrust your weapon at an enemy at great speed. You Stride. At the end of your movement, you make a melee Strike at a creature within reach. On a hit, you can attempt to Shove that creature at your current multi-attack penalty. You only increase your multi-attack penalty after both attacks.

If you have the @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.archetypes.8ad23sFdfBpqwklz]{Aspect of Skies} your Strike gains a +1 circumstance bonus to the Strike’s attack roll if the target is wearing metal armor or made of metal. If you have the @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.archetypes.pid3Nv3o23ilx3n6]{Aspect of Tides}, your Shove gains a +1 circumstance bonus if you move at least 15 feet, or +2 if you move 30 feet.
